subject: Access custody extract for SIG bucket — SSO/SAML & SCIM evidence pull
messages:
From: Maya Patel <compliance@cleardata.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Nguyen <security@cleardata.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request — access custody & SSO/SCIM samples (SIG)

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for taking time on the sig call this morning. ClearData's InfoSec team needs a focused bundle of artifacts for our SIG submission — specifically the "Access custody" section. Can you provide the following by EOD Friday (2027-06-18)?

- Representative SAML assertion samples (including timestamps, audience, and NameID) for web SSO flows.
- A SCIM delta export showing user provisioning/deprovisioning activity for the last 90 days (CSV or JSON lines).
- RBAC role-to-principal mapping for tenant-scoped roles (format acceptable: spreadsheet).
- A single flat list of accounts with last-login timestamp and owner (to validate ownership claims).
- Short explanation (1 paragraph) of how ephemeral/admin elevation is handled and rotation cadence.

We will upload a secure S3 bucket for large logs; otherwise a Drive link is fine. For context, we're covering these items in the SIG questionnaire under sections 7.2 / 8.1. Happy to accept redacted samples if necessary — we only need structure and proof of controls.

Attachment: example CSV header that would be helpful (scim_delta_sample.csv).

Appreciate a point-person for delivery so I can update our tracker.

Best,
Maya Patel
Senior Compliance Manager | ClearData Health

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <compliance@cleardata.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request — access custody & SSO/SCIM samples (SIG)

Hi Maya — thanks for the clear list. I can be the delivery owner for this packet. Quick notes / asks:

- We can supply SAML assertion samples and a SCIM delta CSV. We'll redact any PII and replace identifiers with stable surrogates where needed.
- RBAC mapping: engineering will produce the exported mapping. That will include role id, display name, assigned principals, and scope (tenant/global).
- Last-login list: we can provide login timestamps per account (UTC) and an owner column. If you need ISO vs epoch let me know.
- Ephemeral admin flow: I'll include a short write-up and attach the rotation schedule PDF.

Internal owners: Marissa will pull the SCIM/SCIM delta extraction and the RBAC mapping; Karthik will pull SAML assertion samples and the last-login audit.

We aim to have deliverables staged in a secure S3 location by Thu EOD (2027-06-17) and final package by Fri EOD. If that timeline works, I'll push a Drive manifest and S3 upload instructions once the upload completes.

Deliverables will reference these filenames: saml_assertion_examples.txt, scim_delta_sample.csv, rbac_role_map_snapshot.xlsx.

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Customer Security Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request — access custody & SSO/SCIM samples (SIG)

Quick internal status update — I pulled a 90-day SCIM delta (provision/deprovision events) from the provisioning service. Notes:

- File size before redaction: ~48MB (NDJSON with event type, timestamp, actor, target user id, attributes changed).
- I'll run a one-pass redaction to remove email addresses and replace with stable hashes; timestamps will remain as ISO-8601 in UTC.
- RBAC mapping export is attached as an initial snapshot; it contains role ids, display names, and current member principals. I removed internal service accounts flagged as deprecated.

Upload plan: I'll stage scim_delta_sample.csv and rbac_role_map_snapshot.xlsx to the secure S3 path and then post the link here. If ClearData prefers Drive instead of S3 we can mirror.

Asking Karthik for the saml samples and last-login audit; Karthik — can you drop the assertion examples into the S3 prefix and confirm the manifest?

Thanks — Marissa
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachment stub: rbac_role_map_snapshot.xlsx (contains 4 sheets; sheet1=roles, sheet2=principals, sheet3=scope, sheet4=notes)

From: Alex Nguyen <security@cleardata.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Patel <compliance@cleardata.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 15:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request — access custody & SSO/SCIM samples (SIG)

Thanks team — that timeline sounds good. A couple of clarifications before we consume artifacts:

- For SAML assertions: we only need 3 representative assertions (login, token refresh, service-to-service where SSO is proxied). Please include the raw XML (redacted) and an accompanying note with the verification steps used.
- For SCIM: the delta should include creation and deactivation events; we will not need full attribute blobs, structure/schema + timestamps are the key.
- RBAC mapping: if possible, include the role owner (person or team) column.

We will provide an S3 upload credential (one-time, time-limited) and will delete logs after ingestion. If you prefer to push via Drive we can accept that too, but S3 will speed ingestion to our tooling.

I'll watch for the manifest link and ping the tracker once files are ingested.

-Alex
Security Engineer | ClearData Health
